rootCause: The Astro template split one title string across multiple text/interpolation segments containing parentheses. The compiler hoisted closing head markup between those segments, corrupting all following body markup.
reproduction: Open /resources/ai-prompt-hero/ at 1280x900.
Inspect the document title and resource preview; the title was truncated, the detail DOM was misnested and the preview was too narrow.

Compare the retained before and after captures.

rootCause: PreviewHost treated React's native onChange SyntheticEvent as a resource value instead of reading target.value or target.checked.

Open /resources/select/ and choose Second option.

rootCause: PreviewHost treated MessageEvent.origin as the renderer origin rather than the sender origin, rejecting same-origin application-host messages because the renderer itself is sandboxed.
reproduction: Open /resources/advanced-data-table/ in the local Sites Worker at 360x844.
Send the visible preview update for title People directory and rows []. Before the fix, the filter textbox never appeared.
Open /r/button, click Expressive, and compare the rendered Button class. Before the fix it stayed Quiet.
